### Essay — full interpretation

#### It's Your Time

##### Album / Position

- **Album:** *33* (2022, Big Loud Rock) — **track 2 of 10**, directly after [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Online]] (track 1); the two read as a deliberate pair (see §1). 3:33; ~313k streams. *(Runtime 3:33 on album 33 — master-number motif; noted, not load-bearing.)*
- **Writers:** Roy English, Matt Pauling ([[Sources/Credits/33]]).

##### Lyrics

![[Sources/Lyrics/It's Your Time]]

*(Verified verbatim via Spotify, 2026-05-30 — `status: stable`. The doubled "If you don't know…" line is an intended variation, confirmed across both verses in the source — see §6.)*

---

> **One-line reading:** *It's Your Time* is the earnest twin of *Online*. Where *Online* satirizes the "we come from space" cosmology and deflates it into the surveillance grid, *It's Your Time* states the same structure straight: the soul came from elsewhere, forgot on arrival, and must find its way back. Disguised as a motivational anthem, it's really a song about **remembrance** — the journey is not toward acquisition but toward recollection. And at its center sits the catalogue's clearest cosmological statement of the integration thesis: *a man is like an in-between, animating Heaven and Hell.*

---

##### Grounded

- **Descent-and-forgetting, stated plainly.** *"One you get to Earth you forget where you come from / gotta find your Way back"* — the song's repeated spine. The movement is **return**, not advance; the destination is forgotten, not new.
- **The in-between couplet.** *"A man is like an in-between / Animating Heaven and Hell."*
- **The Fool.** *"Cause I ain't nothing but a Fool"* (opens and recurs); *"with all the things you've ever seen / you still can hardly spell."*
- **The Eye and the Well.** *"Within you got the Eye to see / All the stars under your Belt / And in your heart there is a Well / You can follow where it leads."*
- **The mutating identity line** (appears twice, changed):
  - V1: *"If you don't know who you are to **be** / You still don't know you **fell**."*
  - V2: *"If you don't know Who You Are to **'me'** / You still don't know your **Self**."*
- **Pronouns in scare-quotes.** *"As far as '**I**' can tell"*; *"who you are to '**me**'"*; *"your **Self**"* (capital S).
- **Plain-imperative chorus.** *"It's your Time / All my life I've been waiting for this moment"*; *"Learn to fly / Don't give up / When it's tough / You got just one life to live."*
- **Context (public, Spotify panel):** *33*-era related videos are *welcome to the circus* and *the circle — lucius* (both *Jagwar Twin & sir lucius*); artist bio reads *"There's two sides to every story."*

---

##### Strong Read

###### 1. The earnest twin of *Online* — the album holds both versions of "from above" [W]

*Online* (track 1) and *It's Your Time* (track 2) are **back-to-back**, running the same cosmology in opposite registers. *Online* invokes "we come from space" through a crowd of gurus and **deflates** it — *"but we're stuck / just like a bug inside your database."* *It's Your Time* takes the identical premise **sincerely**, no shrug: *"once you get to Earth you forget where you come from / gotta find your way back."* The split runs *through the record itself*. Read as a pair: *Online* is **external capture** (the system knows you — "they got my face"); *It's Your Time* is **internal amnesia** (you don't know yourself — "you forget where you come from"). The machine remembers everything about you; you remember nothing about you. *(The adjacency is grounded, tracks 1→2; the "deliberate pair" intent is the [W] reading.)*

###### 2. "A man is like an in-between / animating Heaven and Hell" — the integration keystone [W]

The catalogue's clearest cosmological statement of the integration thesis. Man is the **in-between** — the middle of the Tree (Tiferet), hanging between the pillars — and crucially he *animates both* Heaven and Hell. Not chooses Heaven over Hell, not slays the lower: **animates the whole polarity.** This is the [[Jacob & Esau|Jacob/Esau]] "one blessing, two halves" rendered as ontology — the work isn't to eliminate the shadow (Lucius / Esau / Hell) but to be the living middle that holds and vivifies both poles. "Animating" *is* [[The Thread|the Thread]] — feeling as the animating principle. The human vehicle is the channel between registers, and its orientation determines which energy it projects into the material mirror.

###### 3. Anamnesis — the journey as recollection, not acquisition [W]

The structure is **descent → forgetting → remembrance → return**: the soul comes from elsewhere, forgets on arrival in matter, must "find its way back." The obstacle isn't failure or evil — it's *amnesia*. This reframes the motivational surface: "it's your time" sounds like *now is your moment to become something*, but the verses say *now is your moment to remember something.* The Eye already exists, the Well already exists, "all the stars" are already "under your Belt," the path already exists — **the only thing missing is memory.** (The descent-and-return shape proper to Neoplatonic/Gnostic cosmology — see Resonance — and the "from above" the catalogue keeps circling: a fall into forgetting, not an invasion from outside.)

###### 4. "I ain't nothing but a Fool" — Key 0 and "I'm no thing" [W]

Two readings converge on one line. The **Fool** (Tarot Key 0) is the beginning of the journey — the unconditioned traveler who leaves home, learns by experience, takes the leap into matter; "ignorant of worldly logic" (*"you still can hardly spell"*) yet the pure vessel. *And* — "I ain't **no-thing**" is the same **anti-categorization / ego-emptiness** disposition grounded elsewhere (*"I'm no thing,"* [[Roy on Authenticity & Masks]]): the Fool is precisely the one who knows he is no-thing, uncategorized, empty enough to be filled. The line is the disposition and the tarot key at once.

###### 5. The heart-Well and the Eye — the Thread, internalized [W]

*"In your heart there is a Well / you can follow where it leads"* is a [[The Thread|Thread]] statement: the heart as a Well (depth, source, living water) with a current you *follow* — heart-as-navigator, Ariadne's line, feeling as the orienting faculty. Pointedly **in the heart**, not the mind, not achievements, not reputation. Paired with *"within you got the Eye to see / all the stars under your Belt"*: the cosmos internalized, heaven brought inside, the inner Eye opened. Both name an *interior* infrastructure — the opposite vector to *Online*'s outward gaze at the consuming external web.

###### 6. The constructed self vs. the Self — the mutating line [W]

The scare-quotes are on purpose — *"as far as 'I' can tell," "who you are to 'me'"* — the provisional ego flagged as provisional, pointed past toward *"your Self"* (capital S, the Jungian totality). The doubled line carries the whole arc in miniature:
- *"who you are to **be**"* → *"you still don't know you **fell**"* (purpose/being, and the **Fall** that obscured it)
- *"Who You Are to **'me'**"* → *"you still don't know your **Self**"* (relational/social identity, and the **Self** beneath it)

Knowing your role to others isn't knowing yourself; not knowing your purpose isn't yet knowing that you fell. The line teaches by mutating — same frame, deeper each pass. *(Both renderings verified in the stable lyric source — the variation is the device, not a transcription artifact.)*

###### 7. The two "Time" songs — panic and answer [W]

Against [[Sources/Lyrics/Precious Time|Precious Time]] (awakening *too late*; time as panic, the drowning clock), *It's Your Time* is **kairos** — the seized moment, *"all my life I've been waiting for this."* Same noun, opposite charge: *Precious Time* is the terror of the wasted hour; *It's Your Time* is the arrival of the right one.

---

##### Resonance

- **Neoplatonic / Gnostic descent (anamnesis).** *"You came here… you forget where you come from… find your way back"* is the soul's descent into matter, the draught of Lethe (forgetting), the return by recollection — Plotinus's fall-and-ascent; the Gnostic spark that forgets its origin in the dense copy and must remember. *"You still don't know you fell"* names the Fall directly.
- **Tarot — the Fool, Key 0.** The unmanifested spirit before it steps into matter; the traveler who "can hardly spell" yet is the unconditioned vessel. The journey's beginning — fitting for a song about remembering the origin.
- **Hermetic Qabalah — the middle pillar.** *"A man is like an in-between"* tracks the central column; the Eye (perception above) and the Well (Tiferet, the heart-sphere) instruct the seeker to abandon lateral strategy and descend into the heart — opposite to the strategic mind-pole personified by Lucius.

### Essay — full interpretation

#### Online

##### Album / Position

- **Album:** *33* (2022). Spotify track `4rUA1L4SkcF0LL1JVMdzd6`; 2:50; ~670k streams (at capture).
- **Position:** **Track 1 of 10** — the album *opener* (confirmed via the *33* tracklist, 2026-05-30). The pivot reading lands harder for it being the literal first track: *33* opens on the surveillance-jingle.

##### Lyrics

![[Sources/Lyrics/Online]]

*(Lyrics verified verbatim via Spotify, 2026-05-30 — `status: stable`. Note the deliberate homophone puns — see Grounded — that earlier drafts mis-transcribed.)*

---

> **One-line reading:** *Online* is identity collapse staged as a jingle. It diagnoses the predictive-surveillance machine — face captured, brain infiltrated, the self flattened into static and metabolized like prey in a web — and wraps the horror in an upbeat consumer earworm, so the song *is* the sedation it describes. The bridge track: the architecture (database, prediction, "everyone's a guru") that later gets personified as Lucius. The machine precedes the mask.

---

##### Grounded (lyric — verified)

- **Built as an ad — sedation by jingle.** *"Cause you can get it online / Everyone loves the internet / And when you get it online / You feel good / (Feeling good!)"* — a chorus structured like a commercial; the hook indistinguishable from the pitch.
- **Deliberate homophone puns.** *"They know what you like in bed before you come **in two**"* (come into the world / come in two / the sexual sense at once); and the system's offer *"We can help you / **Buy! Buy! Buy!**"* — which later turns to *"**Bye! Bye! Bye!**"*: consumption and farewell as the same sound.
- **The flattening is collective.** *"There's an army up against me and they got my face / Automatic in the static of the human race"*; *"but **we're** stuck / just like a bug inside your database."* The species reduced to static, not one user profiled.
- **Infiltration, then the shrug.** *"They know my every step / they infiltrate my brain / **but it's okay**"* — every horror immediately normalized.
- **The "from above" pile-up.** *"All the mamas and the Lamas say we come from space"* / *"All the shamans and the Brahman's say we come from space (Online!) / Maybe Jupiter is stupider than people say."* Every spiritual authority invoked at once, then deflated by a joke.
- **The closing turn.** *"As machines became more sophisticated… (in the static of the human race) / Thanks to, or because of the internet (in the static)."*

---

##### Public anchors (Grounded — screenshot-verified, filed as Sources)

- **X / @JagwarTwin (5:12 PM, Apr 14 2026):** *"Everyone's a guru. We are now fully in the aquarium"* — [[Sources/Quotes/Roy X Post - Everyone's a Guru (Aquarium)]].
- **Instagram, signed Sir Lucius (🗡🍏):** Lucius ranking the field by the industry scorecard — Jagwar a *"one hit wonder,"* *"bad feeling"* a *"cringe TikTok song"* (*"100 million streams, okay… but he can't sell out a tour… he's not cool"*), peers named — *"Charlie xcx is cool, the 1975 are cool, Chappell Roan…cool, Jagwar…well…"* — closing *"Everyone is an artist or a guru or a dj these days. I'm bored… Your loyal servant, Sir Lucius."* — [[Sources/Quotes/Sir Lucius IG Post - One Hit Wonder]]. *(Caption top truncated in the screenshot; substance verified.)*

---

##### Strong Read

###### 1. Identity collapse under surveillance — the subject, not just the mechanism [W]

Surveillance is the *mechanism*; the *subject* is what surveillance does to identity. The database doesn't just collect — it *"got my face,"* acquiring a duplicate that can be stored, predicted, acted on: the first artificial reflection, a version of the self the system treats as more real than the person who generated it. The earliest stripped-down form of the concern that later mythologizes into mirrors, masks, and the performance-self — the database as a mirror that *replaces* rather than reflects. The horror of *"they know what you like in bed"* isn't the data; it's that **statistical prediction has become indistinguishable from being known** — a counterfeit of [[The Thread|the Thread]]'s genuine witnessing (knowing-for-prediction, not knowing-for-relationship).

###### 2. Satire as sedation — the song is the mechanism [W]

*Online* is funny on purpose, and the comedy is load-bearing: the jingle, the *"Feeling good!"* shout, the *"Buy/Bye"* pun — an upbeat pop confection wrapped around *"they infiltrate my brain."* The repeated *"but it's okay"* is the move: horror → minimization → continued participation, on loop. Not denial — **assimilation**: the subject narrates the loss of autonomy as fine. And the song enacts it: by being an infectious earworm about being metabolized by infectious earworms, *Online* becomes the engine of sedation it diagnoses. Reading it as a grim treatise misses that its power runs through the ridiculous surface. *(Guard, see Open Questions: Roy reportedly called it "fun and ridiculous" — the brightness may be the seduction §2 describes, or it may just be a fun song; hold both.)*

###### 3. The web inverted — prey, not navigator [W]

*"Internet is like a web and we're the Spider's food."* A web is supposed to be connection — the internet's founding myth. The song inverts it: the human is no longer the spider navigating the web for information but the **food**, tracked and digested. The recurring JT reversal in its earliest clear form — circus→cage, mirror→trap, connection→extraction; the promised tool of liberation revealed as the mechanism of capture.

###### 4. "Everyone's a guru" → the aquarium — anti-authority, not syncretist [W]

The *"shamans and Brahmans and mamas and Lamas say we come from space"* pile-up isn't Roy invoking those authorities — it's stacking *every* guru-voice at once to refuse all of them, then deflating the edifice with *"maybe Jupiter is stupider than people say."* The plurality *is* the refusal: every authority talking = none worth deferring to — consistent with his **grounded** anti-categorization stance (*"I'm no thing,"* [[Roy on Authenticity & Masks]]). So: **anti-authority, not all-paths syncretism**; he's mocking the impulse to outsource the answer to a guru. Structurally the song stages collapse — every transcendent claim (*"we come from space"*) is answered by *"but we're stuck / just like a bug inside your database"*: reach for the cosmic, land in the surveillance grid → the totalized closed system, [[The Aquarium|the aquarium]]. *(Anchored, Grounded: Roy's X post — *"Everyone's a guru. We are now fully in the aquarium"* (Apr 14 2026, [[Sources/Quotes/Roy X Post - Everyone's a Guru (Aquarium)]]) — plus the lyric and the grounded "no thing" stance.)*

###### 5. The Lucius IG post — the same line, weaponized [W] (Grounded artifact)

> Rests on the Lucius IG post (screenshot-verified, [[Sources/Quotes/Sir Lucius IG Post - One Hit Wonder]]). One of the cleanest public demonstrations of the Roy/Lucius split in the corpus:

Roy's *"everyone's a guru… fully in the aquarium"* is **rueful** — *we're all trapped performing authority, me included.* The Lucius post would be the **identical observation as contempt** — *you're all beneath me.* Roy's anti-guru = humility (nobody's a guru, including me); Lucius's anti-guru = superiority (everyone's worthless except me). One sentiment split across the two poles, audible in tone alone. And the post is **pure Yesod-metric** — ranking the field by cool/streamable/sellable/tour numbers, the exact value system the music keeps refusing — delivered *on Roy's own account, signed "your loyal servant, Sir Lucius"*: the servant who despises the master, trashing the artist by the industry's scorecard (naming Charli XCX, the 1975, Chappell Roan as "cool" and Jagwar not). The inversion artifact in complete public form.

###### 6. Infrastructure before the character [W]

*Online* maps the conditions that *produce* Lucius before Lucius exists as a named figure: identity → data, attention → currency, prediction → influence, visibility → survival, selfhood → performance. **The database precedes the mask; the algorithm precedes the performer.** Lucius isn't the *creator* of the Circus — he's its most successful native inhabitant. *Online* is the bridge from *Subject to Flooding* (external forces acting on the human) to the *Lucius Lullaby* era (those forces internalized as a voice): control migrating from the outside world into the architecture of the self. Database → prediction → recommendation → habit → identity → self-narration → the voice of Lucius. (Cf. [[Online]] Brain page; [[Machine vs Human]] arc.)

---

##### Resonance

###### Gnostic: the trapped pneuma
The self tracked, bound, and administered inside an inescapable data-matrix maps to the Gnostic spark captured in the Demiurge's dense copy of reality. *"We come from space… but we're stuck like a bug inside your database"* is nearly a one-line statement of the myth: transcendent origin, material entrapment. Escape isn't on offer here — *Online* sits in the captivity, narrating it with a shrug. (Framework correspondence.)

###### The "from above" mytheme — handled obliquely
The *"we come from space"* / shamans-Brahmans-Lamas material gestures at the descended-from-the-sky / ancient-origins archetype. Roy handles it exactly as the charged-material pattern predicts: invoked through a *crowd* of traditions and immediately deflated (the Jupiter joke, the "but it's okay" shrug), so it reads as play, not doctrine. The shape is present; the literal claim refused. **Comparative resonance only — no source claim** (Roy has never named a specific tradition here).

###### Alchemical: a frozen Nigredo
Identity dissolved into automated code — but with no reformation following. The self splits into original and artificial reflection and *stops there*: a blackening with no marriage of opposites, progression frozen by replacing lived experience with simulated optimization. Dissolution without recombination. (Resonance.)

### Brain — structured, tiered claims + anchors

#### Pay Attention (feat. little luna)

Type: Song · *33* (2022, Big Loud Rock), **track 3 of 10**, 3:04. Writers **Roy English + Matt Pauling**; producers both ([[Sources/Credits/33]]). **little luna featured, not a credited writer.** Full reading: [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Pay Attention (feat. little luna)]].

**Core:** **Attention** personified as a speaking power (voiced by JT) that **offers desire and harvests awareness** — the chorus pun *"pay me / pay Attention"* makes the spent currency identical to the extracted resource.

##### Grounded
- Attention speaks in first person; carnival-barker pitch (*"Step right up to my Door… what's in Store"*).
- Names + minimizes a price: *"a little price you pay"*; *"Just a small price and a **rendezvous**."*
- Desires enumerated (money / car / *"big BIG house"* / *"Everybody"*).
- V2 light/mind line: *"They say Stars are Born from Light / And you're so much more than you **Mind**."*
- Bridge scale-up: *"all your ears to the back of the room"* → *"eyes all around my head"* → *"see anything when you see my view"* → *"behind the **Empires** that rise / What they televise is just my **disguise**."*
- Closing naming ritual: *"What's my name? / Attention!"* (×3), then *"MaMa."*

##### Strong Read
- **[W] Attention = the hidden god of the modern world** — tempts by offering, cost understated because the payment *is* awareness.
- **[W] Counterfeit-light** — *"Stars are Born from Light"* / *"more than you Mind"* = sacred/consciousness idiom in the tempter's mouth → [[Sir Lucius]]'s channel-mistaken-for-source error; light/*ohr* ↔ [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Soul Is A Star|Soul Is A Star]].
- **[W] Lucius *function*, not figure** — persuasion-not-force, leverage on existing desire, concealment behind visible structures (*"behind the Empires… televise is my disguise"*). Prototype of [[Sir Lucius]].
- **[W] Form collects the toll** — the *"What's my name? / Attention"* call-and-response makes answering = paying attention; recursive loop, rhymes with [[The Circle|Circle]]/[[Welcome to the Circus|Circus]] (awareness pulled *outward*).
- **Vocal casting (grounded — per the release / Jen):** **Roy = Attention**; **little luna = the guide / introducer / chorus.** little luna is a *character* (MC/recruiter who introduces the listener + voices the chorus-terms), not background vocals. [W] → a **guide-and-deity two-hander**. *(Supersedes the old stub guess that luna = a [[Mary]]/witness function — her role here is the guide who delivers the mark, not the witness. Note the inversion: **Roy voices the tempter** — the persuader-function Lucius usually carries.)*
- **[W-] The Barker's origin — *"Step right up"* begins in Attention's own mouth.** Census `[G]` ×3: here, **Pay Attention (2022)** *"Step right up to my Door… a little price you pay"* → **Good Time (2023)** *"Step right up, get on the floor"* → **Welcome to the Circus (2026)** *"Step right up, shut your mouth."* The GT→WTTC link was already drawn; the **three-point chain rooted in the deity's own 2022 voice** is the new part. The origin matters: in 2022 the barker is **Attention itself**, naming its **price** up front. `[W-]` for the deliberate chain (it *is* a generic carnival call — that's the discount). The **price → party → silence descent** (2022 *price* → 2023 *party* → 2026 *silence*) is `[~]`, **flagged reader-imposed** — don't adjudicate whether the later call is "cheaper" or "more coercive"; just log that what's asked changes. *(33 Deep Dive D8.)*

##### Resonance
Mammon/idolatry · the Demiurge (awareness directed outward) · Hermes/trickster · the Ringmaster (*"step right up"*) · marketplace-of-souls bargain (the *rendezvous*). [~] naming-as-power (El Roy/El Roi). All framework-attributed, not authorial intent.

### Essay — full interpretation

#### Pay Attention (feat. little luna)

> **Provenance:** drafted by the Gemini collaborator; verified/corrected/placed by Code (2026-06-02) against the Spotify-verified lyric ([[Sources/Lyrics/Pay Attention (feat. little luna)]]) and credits ([[Sources/Credits/33]]). **Corrections baked in:** "just a small press" → **"Just a small price and a rendezvous"**; "more than mine" → **"more than you Mind"** (a consciousness line, not a possessive — the draft's "mine" open question is moot); composer question resolved (Matt Pauling = established *33* core, both writer & producer). Vocal roles now grounded (Jen, 2026-06-02): **little luna = guide/introducer/chorus; Roy = Attention.**

##### Album / Position
- **Album:** *33* (2022, Big Loud Rock) — **track 3 of 10**; 3:04. Title styled **"Pay Attention (feat. little luna)"** (lowercase *little luna*).
- **Writers:** **Roy English, Matt Pauling** (both Composer•Lyricist); **Producers:** English & Pauling ([[Sources/Credits/33]]). **little luna is a *featured* artist, NOT a credited writer.** *(Matt Pauling = the recurring 33 co-writer/co-producer — not a mystery, and per vault convention session writers/producers aren't given character entities.)*

##### Lyrics

![[Sources/Lyrics/Pay Attention (feat. little luna)]]

*(Verified verbatim, Spotify, 2026-05-30 — `status: stable`. Stylized caps preserved: Attention, Door, Store, BIG, Stars, Born, Light, Mind, Empires, MaMa.)*

---

> **One-line reading:** the song personifies **Attention** as an ancient power that offers you your desires in exchange for the one thing it actually consumes — your awareness — and stages the transaction as a carnival pitch that collects its toll in the very act of being heard.

---

##### Grounded
- **Two voices, two characters (per the release; confirmed by Jen, 2026-06-02):** **Roy *is* Attention** — he voices the personified power (the first-person pitch, the bridge, the *"What's my name?"* naming). **little luna is the guide / introducer / chorus** — she opens by introducing the listener to Attention (*"Hello, Attention / I'd like to introduce you to someone"*) and carries the recurring chorus that states the terms. So the song is a **two-hander**: a guide who delivers the mark, and the deity who collects.
- **Attention speaks in first person** (Roy) — opens after luna's introduction and delivers the pitch.
- **Carnival-barker register:** *"Step right up to my Door… But I can show you what's in Store."*
- **Names a price and minimizes it:** *"There's a little price you pay"*; later *"Just a small price and a rendezvous."* (The bargain includes a **rendezvous** — a meeting/tryst, not only a fee.)
- **The desires enumerated:** *"You want the money? / You want the car? / You want the big BIG house? … Everybody"* — the wants asserted as universal.
- **The chorus puns payment on awareness:** *"Everybody's gotta pay me / You gotta pay Attention"* — the currency you spend *is* the resource being harvested.
- **Cosmological flattery (V2):** *"They say Stars are Born from Light / And you're so much more than you Mind"* — light/origin imagery, and a **mind/consciousness** line (you are *more than your mind*).
- **The bridge expands the narrator's scale:** *"May I have all your ears to the back of the room"* → claims omnipresent perception *"I got eyes all around my head"* → offers to control the view *"you can see anything when you see my view"* → and claims position behind history/media: *"I've been behind the Empires that rise / What they televise is just my disguise."*
- **Closing naming ritual:** *"What's my name? / Attention!"* (×3, escalating), then the chorus, then a final *"MaMa."*

##### Strong Read

###### 1. Attention is the hidden god of the modern world [W]
A conversation with a *force*, not a person. It tempts by **offering**, never threatening — money, status, security, recognition. The cost stays understated precisely because the payment *is* awareness. The chorus pun ("pay me" / "pay Attention") states the thesis outright: the currency spent and the resource extracted are one substance.

###### 2. It co-opts the language of light to make the bargain holy [W]
*"They say Stars are Born from Light"* puts cosmological/sacred vocabulary in the tempter's mouth; *"you're so much more than you Mind"* flatters the listener with a soul-beyond-mind promise. This is the **counterfeit-light** move — a lower, acquisitive power borrowing a higher source's idiom — structurally the error the vault attributes to [[Sir Lucius]] (mistaking the channel for the source). Ties to the light/*ohr* framework and to [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Soul Is A Star|Soul Is A Star]] (soul/star/light). *(Leap, flagged: the lines could be plain flattery; the *ohr* correspondence is the reader's frame, not stated intent.)*

###### 3. The bridge reveals the true scale of the narrator [W]
The intimate pitch widens to a room, then to *"behind the Empires that rise,"* with television as *"my disguise."* Empires rise and fall; Attention remains. The narrator is reframed from a psychological pressure into a **trans-historical constant** that kingdoms, institutions, and media all compete to capture.

###### 4. Attention is an early prototype of the Sir Lucius *function* (not the figure) [W]
Lucius doesn't appear, but Attention carries his operating signature — now grounded in the text: **persuasion not force** (*"I can show you," "I'll get it for you"*); **leverage on existing desire**; **intimate knowledge of the want**; **concealment behind visible structures** (*"behind the Empires," "televise is just my disguise"*); proprietary authority. The song works the territory [[Sir Lucius]] later personifies. The function, not the character.

###### 5. little luna is the Guide; Roy is Attention — a two-hander [grounded vocal roles + [W] reading]
**Vocal casting (grounded, per the release / Jen):** **little luna = the guide / introducer / chorus**; **Roy = Attention.** That makes little luna a *character*, not a featured-vocalist garnish: she is the **MC / recruiter** who introduces the listener to the deity (*"I'd like to introduce you to someone"*) and then voices the **chorus** that states the terms (*"Everybody's gotta pay me / you gotta pay Attention"*). Roy plays **Attention itself** — the tempter-deity making the pitch. [W] The structure is therefore a **guide-and-deity dialogue**: luna delivers the mark and frames the demand; Roy/Attention offers and harvests. *(Note the inversion of the usual JT casting: here **Roy voices the tempter** — the persuader-function Lucius normally carries — while a second voice guides the listener toward him. Worth tracking against the Roy/Lucius split, but flag, don't force.)*

###### 6. The song enacts its own bargain — the form collects the toll [W]
The closing *"What's my name? / (Attention)"* makes **answering** the entity's name an act of paying attention — the very payment the song describes. The work performs its content: to engage the question is to pay. A closed loop (the demand creates the surrender it asks for), rhyming with the recursive [[The Circle|Circle]]/[[Welcome to the Circus|Circus]] architecture — same structure, awareness pulled *outward*. *(Defensible from the call-and-response form.)*

###### 7. Temptation through consent — the JT pattern, distilled [W]
Attention compels no one; the listener is invited and **assents**. The danger is not external domination but the willing surrender of agency for comfort, validation, status. The bargain works because the mark already wants what's offered. The catalogue's purest statement of this move.

##### Resonance
- **Mammon / idolatry** — money/status/visibility as objects of devotion; *"pay attention"* as ritual offering, *"what's my name?"* as demand for invocation. Framework correspondence, not intent.
- **The Demiurge** — lower powers holding consciousness captive by directing awareness *outward*: *"see anything when you see my view," "eyes all around."* Attention redirects perception rather than creating truth. Framework correspondence.
- **Hermes / trickster** — messenger, advertiser, dealer, intermediary; promises access while staying invisible behind the message.
- **The Ringmaster** — *"Step right up"* is barker language; orchestrates spectacle while hidden behind it. Textual anticipation of [[Welcome to the Circus]].
- **The marketplace of souls** — payment/desire/exchange vocabulary echoes bargain-for-power myths; transaction internal, structure identical (power by bargain, not conquest). The *"rendezvous"* sharpens the deal/tryst register.
- **[~] The naming demand** — *"What's my name?"* as power-through-naming resonates with the vault's name-as-power material (El Roy / El Roi throat motif). Pointer only.

##### I. The grounded floor — what actually holds

**[G] Track 5 of 10 — the center of *33*.** ([[Sources/Lyrics/Soul Is A Star]], 3:17.) The Joni co-write and the soul-transmission thesis sit at the album's **literal midpoint**. **[W] It is the album's anamnesis pivot:** SiaS is where *33* first poses its governing question — *"do you know who you are?"* — which the record then works through and resolves into doctrine at the close ([[The Circle]], *"the inside of the inside"*). (Arc detail in §II-A.)

The Joni connection is more than shared-philosophy inference, but the floor is **smaller than the draft claimed**. What's genuinely grounded:

- **[G] The co-write.** Joni Mitchell is co-credited on "Soul Is A Star" (*33*, 2022) — Spotify Credits, [[Sources/Credits/33]]. This alone makes her a **confirmed influence** on the album (the credit is the anchor the whole Joni thread rests on — see [[Sources/Reference/Joni Mitchell - Ladies of the Canyon (reference)]]).
- **[?] The interpolation's nature.** That the track carries a *non-lyrical interpolation of Woodstock using Joni's actual voice* is **the draft's claim, unverified here.** Our position: non-verbatim, likely musical; actual-voice **unconfirmed** (pin Hall of Mirrors).
- **[G→ verified bio] The stated childhood influence** (Joni + Dylan, mother played them) — Masquerade Atlanta venue bio, **confirmed verbatim 2026-06-02**: *"grew up serenaded by the lucid new romance storytelling of Joni Mitchell and Bob Dylan, who the singer's mom played around the house"* ([[Masquerade-Atlanta-Venue-Bio]]; [[Brain/Roy Voice/Roy on Influences]]). Caveat: it's a **bio / PR statement** (third-person), so a published-statement anchor rather than Roy's first-person words — but it's real and citable. *(Separately, the board's "dad sent me Woodstock / his favorite Joni song" is a Roy-exposed DM — citable per [[_System/Boundaries]] — but wording flagged for OCR re-check, and it's "dad," not "mother." Don't merge them.)*

**Why even the reduced floor clears the bar.** The vault's tier test: *would this overlap surprise someone, or is it just two esoteric artists?* A fought-for **co-write credit** + a **near-quoted identity question** + the **seed/garden weld** is denser than coincidence — it crosses from shared-lineage `[~]` into **transmission `[W]`**, anchored by the `[G]` credit. The *actual-voice* claim, **if** sourced, would push it further; until then it's the load-bearing `[?]`.

##### II. The parallel inventory

Both songs public; both lyric sets are in-vault ([[Sources/Lyrics/Soul Is A Star]]; [[Sources/Reference/Joni Mitchell - Ladies of the Canyon (reference)]]). Quotes kept to short fragments.

| Beat | *Woodstock* (Mitchell) | *Soul Is A Star* (English) | Tier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Chance meeting w/ a stranger | "came upon a child of God" | "I met a man who had a son" | [W] structural |
| The humble request | "can I walk beside you?" | "can I sing you just one verse?" | [W] structural |
| The identity question | "I don't know who I am" | "do you know who you are?" | [W] the mirror |
| Stardust ↔ star | "we are stardust" | "your soul is a star" | [W] textual echo |
| Garden ↔ seeds | "back to the garden" | "we fall down as seeds on the ground" | [W] he supplies the Fall; she the destination |
| The bargain / the trap | "caught in the devil's bargain" | "gave it up before **Prophets** ever turned" | [W] *Prophets/profits homophone* — see note |

**Both lyric sides are individually grounded; the *parallels* are `[W]`** (the lines exist; that they rhyme is the read). **Corrected anamnesis arc:** the identity question runs *forgetting* (Woodstock: "I don't know who I am") → *question* (SiaS chorus: "do you know who you are?") → a momentary *statement* in the SiaS **bridge** ("Know Who you are") → **back to the question at the close.** So the arc reaches toward recollection and then **withholds resolution** — it ends unresolved (cf. §IX). *(The draft's "the *do* is dropped in the outro" is not the verified text — the song's final line is the question.)* `[W]`

**The Prophets/profits note:** the verified word is **"Prophets"** — *the son dies before the prophets turn* (before recognition/vindication arrives). The "profits"/"devil's bargain" reading is the **homophone** Roy almost certainly intends as a double-meaning, but the literal lyric is "Prophets." Keep both; don't quote "profits" as the text.

##### II-A. Place in the *33* argument [W]

With the album now fully mapped, SiaS reads as the **hinge of a single arc**, not an isolated Joni song *(track numbers + themes [G]; the arc-reading [W])*:
- **3 [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Pay Attention (feat. little luna)|Pay Attention]] / 4 [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/I Like to Party|I Like to Party]]** — the attention-force pulls awareness **outward**; people *"stay in and pretend."* This is the **forgetting** (cf. - **7 [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Down to You|Down to You]]** — the **inward refusal:** *"one cannot live on bread alone"*; names and rejects the very gods that consumed the girl — *"is it fame? is it money?"* ↔ SiaS *"she wanted Love but got Fame and Power from The Thieves."*

SiaS poses the question at the center (5); The Circle resolves it at the close (10).

- **[W] Two ends of one arc.** *Woodstock* = the boy at dawn walking to "get my soul free." *Soul Is A Star* = the same soul after "the world took him" — "wrote songs you never heard… gave it up before Prophets ever turned." The hinge is Woodstock's own "caught in the devil's bargain" — **confirmed Joni's own line** (in her official published lyrics, all versions; Jen, 2026-06-02).
- **[?] Hold at archetype, not biography.** "Same literal person" is the leap; keep it at descending-soul archetype.

##### IV. The girl (verse 2)

- **[W] The girl carries Joni — adopted reading (Jen, 2026-06-13; this REVERSES the prior "laundering" ruling — it is Roy's own framing).** The verse-2 girl is breadcrumbed to **Joni Mitchell**, woven through as the song's voice and witness (hint, never flatly named — the discovery is meant to be walked). The trail, all grounded: Joni **co-wrote SiaS** `[G]`; the **Witness** who *"came upon the child of God"* in 1969 is her *Woodstock*, set inside the later song still singing *"I can see it"*; *"bullet in her **genes**"* rhymes with Joni's *"the cleaner's press was in my **jeans**"* (The Boho Dance — the genes/jeans hinge); *"wanted Love but got Fame and Power from **The Thieves**"* is Joni's own fame-bargain lexicon (the *"star maker machinery"* — For the Roses / Free Man in Paris); and Joni is the childhood voice the mother *"played around the house."* **The dark father** (*"papa was a sinner playin' God behind the scenes"*) reads as the **star-maker / industry patriarch** who made-and-exploited her (cf. Joni's own *Free Man in Paris* — Geffen *"stoking the star maker machinery"*), **NOT her literal father** — so the adoption stays non-defamatory: Joni is the spirit and source woven through the girl; the verse is myth, not a biographical exposé of her family. *(Separate & still `[?]`: whether her **actual voice** is in the recording — reversing the girl=Joni framing does NOT settle the audio-interpolation question; pin Hall of Mirrors.)*
- **[W] Feminine counterpart to the son's descent.** Son = soul lost through self-sacrifice; girl = soul lost through fame + poisoned inheritance — masculine/feminine, the Hermetic **Gender** polarity (board's Kybalion Principle 7). → [[Duality]] (heart-mind / polarity).
- **[W] HIGH VALUE — "The Thieves" = Joni's industry-as-thief lexicon.** The capitalized *"Power from **The Thieves**"* is now anchorable in Joni's documented commodification vocabulary — *"star maker machinery,"* the *"golden egg… tossed by the company,"* thieves who *"buy and sell"* (dossier Part 1, [[Sources/Reference/Joni Mitchell — JT-relevant analysis (research dossiers)]]; **cite the underlying Joni songs/credit, never the dossier**). Because **Joni co-wrote SiaS** `[G]`, the lexicon plausibly enters *through her register* rather than as a generic word. **This is now part of the breadcrumb trail to Joni** (see the adopted reading above), one of the load-bearing clues — not merely ambient lexicon.

The girl is the soul that *took* it. Road-not-taken, not portrait. *(For Free is on the [[Sources/Reference/Joni Mitchell - Ladies of the Canyon (reference)|Ladies of the Canyon]] reference.)*
- **[W] "bullet in her genes" = the ancestral-wound node** — inherited corruption that transmits cleanly. Ties to the genetic-repair / "lost the vowels" thread and the sterile-banana symbol (independent vault work, not the board's layout).

##### V. The inheritance architecture (core thesis) [W]

**A transmission that arrives corrupted but recoverable — wound and wisdom handed down together.**

- **[W] Two verses = two halves of one inheritance, packed in a seed** — the thing that fell + the thing that will grow. *The falling is the planting.*
- **[W] Burial over destruction.** What goes into the ground waits — latent, not dead. The JT default across the corpus: the kid "let go" and returned for (Ballerina Boy), "hid the song inside their wings… left them to sing" ([[The Circle]]), Lucius as light *contained* not extinguished, the Loop. → proposed concept (§XI).
- **[W] "Angels and angles."** The **consonants** descend — the wound inherits easily (fixed architecture, the bones of the word); the **breath / vowels** are what's lost. "He wrote songs you never heard" = the breath that didn't cross. → proposed *Vowels* update (§XI).
- **[W] Pain transmits more reliably than wisdom** — the bullet made it into the genes; the songs didn't make it out of the room. *(Defensible from the two verses; flagged as framing, not fact.)*

So SiaS's *"living thread from a song that stayed strong for half a century"* (Joni's voice tied to the buried inheritance) is **the same gesture as The Circle's wise one re-grasping the string**; and *"songs you never heard"* ↔ The Circle's *"hid the song inside their wings… left them to sing"* — in both, the song goes **latent** (§V's word) and is recovered by **remembrance**, not retrieval. *(Cross-link strengthens the **reading**; §VIII's actual-voice basis stays `[?]`.)*

##### IX. The unresolved tension (preserve — don't resolve) [W]

Is the work **fighting** the asymmetry (pain transmits, wisdom doesn't) or **accepting** it?
- **Rosicrucian:** re-tune, recover, repair — the world is out of tune, not evil → fighting it.
- **Gnostic:** parasitic loop, bullet in the genes, sterile banana → corruption structural, recovery partial.

*Soul Is A Star* doesn't settle it — **and the corrected outro confirms this**: the song ends back on the **question**, not a resolved statement. The son still died; the girl was consumed; the witnessing **sees** the soul but does not **save** the man. Hope and tragedy held in one hand without either winning — the most honest thing in the song.

##### XIV. Methodological notes

- **Adjacency ≠ annotation** (board rule): a cell *near* a lyric block isn't necessarily *about* it. Worked example — "Mom's song" (grasshopper video) sits near the SiaS block and is unrelated. Any board-layout reading must pass "confirm relationship, not just proximity."
- **Floor vs. structure:** the **co-write is the floor**; the actual-voice interpolation is *not yet* part of it. State the floor honestly and let the interpretation rest visibly on it.
- **Tier-3 surprise test:** surprise → log; wallpaper → note once as shared lineage and move on.

##### Appendix A — Forum-ready prose (Jen's public-facing version, verbatim)

*Preserved as landed. **Note for any public use:** the "actual inherited voice" line below states as fact the very claim flagged `[?]` above — confirm the Hall-of-Mirrors source before posting publicly.*

> But see — it's all coming down from above, so of course they share a philosophy. The influence is stronger than that.
>
> It's the sheer number of parallels: the turns of phrase, the symbolic imagery, and the fact that Soul Is a Star samples Woodstock while overlapping it so heavily.
>
> The child of God *is* the son, going to Woodstock to get his soul free. He's also Jesus, Mozart… all of us.
>
> Both songs open the same way — a chance meeting with a stranger, a humble request. *I don't know who I am* → *Do you know who you are?* → *You know who you are.* Seeds fall down. Back to the garden.
>
> This is the not-so-secret foundation — and, I assume, a hard-fought-for co-write credit.
>
> ---
>
> My read comes down to one line: a transmission that arrives corrupted, but recoverable. Wound and wisdom tangled together — one whole, one battered and forgotten.
>
> The two verses are two halves of one inheritance, packed in a seed. The dead thing that fell, and the living thing that will grow.
>
> The falling is the planting.
>
> It echoes angels and angles. The consonants come down — the wound inherits easily, keeps its shape across generations, the fixed architecture, the bones of the word.
>
> But the breath is what's lost.
>
> The song you never heard.
>
> So he did something. He took a living thread from a song that stayed strong for half a century, and tied it to the descending inheritance that had forgotten itself.
>
> He put Joni's actual inherited voice into his song — not words, just breath and sound and spirit. Soul, not structure.
>
> A part he could have made himself, and the song would be no worse for it… but chose not to — so the song that still remembered itself could become the second half of the inheritance, and whisper remembrance to the seeds in the ground.
>
> It isn't "the song" handed down by the older generation. It's "the song" called back by name — reminded, repaired. The whole foundation, the lore leaking into reality again with a shattering subtlety… just sitting right there on Spotify.
>
> We can make "Roy is a millennial Joni Mitchell" funny again. Maybe not this part, though. Because… damn.
>
> And that's only the foundation of the ties. There are many more — just none quite as profound as watching mythology cycle through.

### Brain — structured, tiered claims + anchors

#### The Circle

Type: Song · *33* (2022), **track 10 of 10 — album closer**, 3:50. **Roy English (sole writer)**; Roy + Pauling produce. The foundational **Jagwar-myth** song; the most explicit statement of the `CONCEPT-TheCircle` mythos and the **origin of [[The Thread]]**. The 2026 [[The Circle (Lucius Version)]] re-sings it through Lucius. Full reading: [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/The Circle]].

**Core:** a feminine **maker** holding a world on a string makes the **Jagwars** (the artist's namesake) and teaches them to **sing**; kings persuade them they cannot; she **hides the song inside their wings** *"on the inside of the inside"* and withdraws; empires cage and sell — until a **wise one** finds the old cave and **remembers she once held the string**, and the circle grows *"from the inside of the inside."* The album's closing word.

##### Grounded
- *"Long ago, there was a Jagwar with a world tied on a string / And she made other Jagwars, then taught them to sing."* **Spelling = "Jagwar"** (the namesake), not "jaguar."
- Immanence → withdrawal: *"she would come down… and she'd walk with the Jagwars"* → *"hid the song inside their wings / On the inside of the inside, then left them to sing."*
- Loss by **persuasion**, in cycles: *"Many cycles… with their kings / And the new kings told Jagwars they never could sing."*
- Degradation: *"the empires built cages and sold everything."*
- Recovery by **remembrance**: *"a wise one found a small cave… And the wise one remembered she once held the string."*
- Refrain/doctrine (album's final words): *"The circle will grow / From the inside of the inside… But the inside of the inside must be where you go."* Maker + wise one both **"she."**

##### Strong Read
- **[W] The foundational Jagwar myth + the namesake** — the project is named for the myth's made-and-divided creatures; *"made other Jagwars"* ↔ *"One, become Two"* ([[Another Way II Heaven]] / [[The Pattern]] board cosmogony).
- **[W] The gift is song, not power** — song = essence; the tragedy is being convinced it was never theirs.
- **[W] Loss is belief, not theft** — *"told Jagwars they never could sing"* = the exact mechanism the attention/spectacle tracks ([[Pay Attention (feat. little luna)]], [[I Like to Party]]) dramatize, named at the mythic root.
- **[W] "Hid the song inside their wings"** — sought thing already present; remembrance not acquisition. **Public source** of "the song hidden inside its wings" (citable per [[Boundaries]]).
- **[W] The string = [[The Thread]]** — *world-on-a-string* + *she once held the string* → the Thread originates here.
- **[W] Descent-and-withdrawal** (immanence → conceal-and-retreat) = tzimtzum-like; same shape as [[Another Way II Heaven]].
- **[W] Inside-of-the-inside reverses the attention vector** — circle grows from the deepest interior; **the album's mythic cure for its own outward attention-pull** (vs [[Welcome to the Circus]]' outward recursion).
- **[W] Remembrance over conquest; the wise one as Sophia/Shekinah** (feminine maker + feminine rememberer). "She" grounded; the ID is the read.
- **[W/~] The Wise One has two faces (Jen, 2026-06-09):** **(1) cosmic/source** — *"she once held the string"* = she *was* the Maker → the divine feminine, Sophia/Shekinah ([[Mary]]'s register); **(2) immanent/collective** — the song is hidden *"inside their wings"* (inside **every** Jagwar = us), so the Wise One is also the **template of remembrance any of us instantiates** — *us, remembering;* the **Christ-as-exemplar** pattern (a Jesus, a Bowie, a Prince), tied to the title **33** = Christ's age `[~]`. **Both at once** via the Gnostic hinge: the spark inside each, *remembered,* reunites with the source — so personal awakening and reunion with the cosmic Maker are the same event. *(Don't over-collapse the three names — family resemblance, not equation; her defining act, remembrance, is more Sophia/Shekinah than conventional Mary.)*
- **Source flag:** *"Inside of the Inside"* is a **NotebookLM artifact** (AI Audio-Overview + grounded notes) — a *source-citing finding-aid* (valuable for tracing), but **`citable: false` as output.** Trace its primaries; ground only on public/citable ones; **check the upload set for private material** ([[_System/Boundaries]]). Its AI-host lines (*"blue jeans / California corner / ABC"*) are **AI synthesis, not Roy,** unless traced to an uploaded source. Gemini's error: treating the AI hosts as authorial. The reads here stand on the **public lyric**.

### Essay — full interpretation

#### The Circle

> **Provenance:** drafted by Gemini; verified/corrected/placed by Code (2026-06-02) against [[Sources/Lyrics/The Circle]] (Spotify-verified, stable) + [[Sources/Credits/33]]. **All quotes confirmed verbatim, "Jagwar" spelling confirmed.** Corrections: **track 10 of 10 / album closer** (draft's "track 3" was wrong — that's [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Pay Attention (feat. little luna)|Pay Attention]]); **writer credit RESOLVED — Roy English (sole writer)**, English + Pauling produce (the `[?]` is closed); links repaired (`[[The Kingdom]]`→`CONCEPT-Malkhut`, etc.).

##### Album / Position
- **Album:** *33* (2022, Big Loud Rock) — **track 10 of 10, the album closer**; 3:50. **Writer: Roy English (sole)**; Producers: Roy English & Matt Pauling ([[Sources/Credits/33]]). *(Roy's solo authorship matters: this is **his** mythic statement, not a co-write — like [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Another Way II Heaven|Another Way II Heaven]].)*
- The **33 original** — distinct from [[Sources/Lyrics/The Circle (Lucius Version)]] (the 2026 Lucius reworking). This is the foundational Jagwar myth; the most explicit statement of the `CONCEPT-TheCircle` mythos.

> [!important] Spelling
> Official lyric spelling is **"Jagwar/Jagwars"** (the artist's own spelling, not "jaguar"). The myth's creatures **share the project's name** — that's the point, not a typo.

##### Lyrics

![[Sources/Lyrics/The Circle]]

*(Verified verbatim, Spotify, 2026-05-30 — `status: stable`.)*

---

> **One-line reading:** a creation myth — a feminine maker holding a world on a string makes the **Jagwars** and teaches them to **sing**; kings persuade them they cannot; she hides the song *inside* them and withdraws; empires cage and sell — until a **wise one** finds the old cave and **remembers she once held the string**, and the circle begins to grow again *from the inside of the inside.* The album's closing word.

---

##### Grounded
- **A third-person myth:** *"Long ago, there was a Jagwar with a world tied on a string / And she made other Jagwars, then taught them to sing."*
- **Immanence then withdrawal:** *"She would come down to the empires of the Earth, Wind, and the Sea / And she'd walk with the Jagwars."*
- **Loss by persuasion, in cycles:** *"Many cycles of the story came and went with their kings / And the new kings told Jagwars they never could sing."*
- **Concealment-within, then retreat:** *"So the maker of the Jagwars hid the song inside their wings / On the inside of the inside, then left them to sing."*
- **Degradation into capture/commerce:** *"the Earth changed, and the sky raged… the empires built cages and sold everything."*
- **Recovery by remembrance:** *"'Til a wise one found a small cave where the Jagwars used to sing / And the wise one remembered she once held the string."*
- **The doctrine-refrain (the album's final words, to fade):** *"The circle will grow / From the inside of the inside… But the inside of the inside must be where you go."*
- Both maker and wise one are **"she."**

##### Strong Read

###### 1. The foundational Jagwar myth — and the namesake [W]
The catalogue's origin story: where the **Jagwars** came from, what was lost, how, and how it returns. The creatures are *Jagwars* — **the artist's own name**; "**Jagwar Twin**" reads as a self-identification with the made-and-divided creatures of this song. The maker who *makes others* is the same gesture as the One becoming two in [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Another Way II Heaven|Another Way II Heaven]] / the board cosmogony ([[The Pattern]]). As closer, it's the record's resolving word.

> **Earliest documented naming (2019) — the doctrine predates this song.** *The Circle* (this *33* closer, 2022) is the **fully-narrated, mythologized** statement of a doctrine Roy had already been speaking aloud **three years earlier.** In the *Subject to Flooding* press cycle he names it directly, attached to **[[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Move To You]]**: *"there is no beginning and no end — it's just a circle,"* felt live when the crowd sings it back (none — Digital Journal **2019-09-23**, [[Sources/Transcripts/Digital-Journal-2019-Move-To-You-Loser]]). So the keystone was **laid in the debut era, on its most vulnerable song** — which gives the "*33* grew from *Subject to Flooding*'s flood-rich soil" thesis a literal receipt (see [[Subject to Flooding (album)]]). `[G]` the 2019 naming · `[W]` this song as its mythic elaboration.

###### 2. The gift is song, not power [W]
The maker gives neither wealth, dominion, nor knowledge — she teaches them to **sing**. Song = essence (authentic expression, identity, participation in creation). The tragedy isn't losing a possession — it's being convinced the essence was never theirs.

###### 3. The loss is belief, not theft [W]
*"The new kings told Jagwars they never could sing."* The song is never taken — the Jagwars are **persuaded** it never existed. Authority gained by convincing them something inherent is absent. **This is the exact mechanism the attention/spectacle tracks dramatize** ([[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Pay Attention (feat. little luna)|Pay Attention]] / [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/I Like to Party|I Like to Party]]) — here named at the mythic root.

###### 4. "Hid the song inside their wings" — the governing paradox [W]
The maker preserves the song **within** the Jagwars, *"on the inside of the inside."* What's sought is already present; the journey is **remembrance, not acquisition** — the catalogue's central paradox stated as plot. *(This line is the **public source** of the "song hidden inside its wings" phrasing — citable per [[_System/Boundaries]].)*

###### 5. The string is the Thread [W]
*"A world tied on a string"* (the maker) and *"she once held the string"* (the wise one) are the same filament — the connection to the source, Ariadne's thread back through the maze of cages and empires. Remembering = re-grasping the string. **This song is where [[The Thread]] originates** — *world-on-a-string* and *song-in-the-wings* both born here.

###### 6. A descent-and-withdrawal cosmology [W]
The maker *"comes down" and "walks with"* the Jagwars (immanence), then *"hid the song inside… and left them to sing"* (withdrawal). Emanation → concealment-and-retreat — the same shape as [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Another Way II Heaven|Another Way II Heaven]], structurally parallel to **tzimtzum** (the maker contracts, leaving the divine hidden within creation). The inward-hiding is *why* "the inside of the inside" is the only route back.

###### 7. Inside-of-the-inside reverses the attention vector [W]
Where the album's attention-force pulls awareness **outward** (and [[Welcome to the Circus]] runs the same recursion outward), here the circle *"will grow / from the inside of the inside"* — outward growth **sourced from the deepest interior.** Same recursive shape, opposite direction. The repeated instruction is a manifesto: **go inward, not further out.** As closer, this is the album's **mythic cure for its own attention-disease.**

###### 8. Remembrance over conquest; the wise one as Sophia [W]
The resolution defeats no enemy and seizes no kingdom — *"the wise one remembered."* Memory placed above victory. That the rememberer is **"the wise one" and feminine** maps her onto **Sophia / Shekinah** (wisdom recovering the thread), paired with the feminine maker: source and remembering both feminine. *(The "she" is grounded; the Sophia/Shekinah ID is the read.)*

###### 9. The circle grows by spreading remembrance [W]
A circle expanding from a center — the plot tracks it (hidden → remembered → sung → grown). Growth is **organic and by awakening**, not coercion; the forgetting came *"in cycles… with their kings,"* and the remembering reverses the cycle into a growing circle.

###### 10. The Wise One's two faces — the source, and the template ("all of us") [W / ~]
The Wise One is not one *or* the other of two readings — the song's own doctrine makes her **both**, joined at the act of remembrance:
- **The cosmic / source face `[W]`:** she *"remembered she once held the string"* — so she **was** the Maker; seeker and maker are two phases of one feminine being (the loop). That face is the divine-feminine source — **Sophia / Shekinah** (and [[Brain/Characters/Mary|Mary]]'s register; §8).
- **The immanent / collective face `[W/~]` (Jen's read):** because the song was hidden *"inside their wings"* — inside **every** Jagwar — the Wise One is also the **template of remembrance that any of us can instantiate.** "Jagwar Twin" *is* self-identification with the made creatures; we are the Jagwars who were told we couldn't sing. So the Wise One = **us, remembering** — and the **exemplars who completed the circle** (*a Jesus, a Bowie, a Prince*: the ones who remembered the song and sang it back). This is the **Christ-as-exemplar** move — not a god above us but the *pattern* of awakening any spark can follow (theosis; "the kingdom within"; cf. the album title **33** = Christ's age `[~]`). **Roy grounds this publicly** (X, 2026; [[Sources/Quotes/Roy X Posts - June 2026 (aphorisms)]]): *"Jesus is my North Star," "I'm here to serve Jesus"* (Christ-as-guide); *"Every person has it inside of them. The trick is getting it inside out"* + *"If it's happening for me it's happening for everyone"* (the song-inside-everyone / the collective); *"Meet David Bowie"* (the exemplar). The "all of us / Christ-as-exemplar" face is now Roy-anchored, not only inferred.
- **Why both at once (the Gnostic hinge):** in this cosmology the spark inside each person — the song in the wings — *remembered*, **reunites with the source.** So a personal awakening and reunion with the cosmic Maker are the **same event**, which is exactly why the Wise One can be the divine feminine **and** "all of us": to remember you once held the string *is* to rediscover your identity with the One who held it. Source and seeker meet in **anamnesis**. → `CONCEPT-Malkhut` (the spark within); the vessel/"download" doctrine ([[The Upload]] / [[The Pattern]]).

> **Source discipline (do not over-collapse; do not over-ground):** the three names stay a **family resemblance**, not an equation — *Marian vessel / Gnostic Sophia / Kabbalistic Shekinah* — and the Wise One's defining act (**remembrance**) is **more Sophia/Shekinah than conventional Mary** (CLAUDE.md §register-collapse). *"Inside of the Inside"* is a **NotebookLM artifact** (an AI Audio-Overview "podcast" + grounded notes) — a *source-grounded, source-citing finding-aid* (**valuable** for tracing to primaries), **but `citable: false` as output** (never cite the NotebookLM synthesis itself). **Handling:** trace each claim to the primary it cites and ground on that primary **iff public/citable**; the AI hosts *interpret/extrapolate* the uploads, so conversational lines like *"blue jeans / California corner / ABC"* are **AI synthesis — not Roy's intent — unless traced to an actual uploaded source**; and **check the upload set for private material** . Gemini's error was treating the AI-host interpretation as **authorial**. The *"Themes, Parallels" doc* is likewise a finding-aid. The readings above stand on the **public lyric** + existing canon.

##### Resonance
- **The music of creation (Ainulindalë)** — creation taught/sustained as *song* resembles Tolkien's world sung into being. Framework correspondence.
- **Divine spark / kingdom within** — the song concealed within the Jagwars = the essential truth hidden in the individual, uncovered not acquired (`CONCEPT-Malkhut`).
- **Eden remembered / the Cave** — a fall into forgetfulness and recovery of an original relation; the *"small cave where the Jagwars used to sing"* (and a Plato's-cave *inversion* — here the cave holds the truth, not the shadows).
- **Tzimtzum / the Great Work** — withdrawal leaving the divine hidden within (Lurianic); caged fragmentation → remembered reintegration (tikkun).
- **[~] Joni's "Circle Game"** — *"round and round… captive on the carousel of time… in the circle game"* (cf. [[Sources/Reference/Joni Mitchell - Ladies of the Canyon (reference)]]): the **trapped carousel** vs JT's **circle that grows from within** — a dialogue (same image, opposite charge). Feeds the pending `33 (album)` Joni consolidation. `[~]`/`[W]` (Joni is a confirmed *33* influence).

"No triumph" ≠ "stays in shadow" — the shadow gets the last *track* (15); the thread gets the last thing it can't metabolize (14). Full arc: [[Essays/Arcs/Lucius Lullaby]].

### Brain — structured, tiered claims + anchors

#### #1 Champion (la Conquistadora)

Type: Song — Track 8, [[Lucius Lullaby (album)]]. Writers: **Cici Ward, Roy English, Tony Esterly** ([[Sources/Credits/Lucius Lullaby]]); string + choir arrangement. The ego's boast-anthem that **diagnoses itself through the way it looks at Mary** — and is unseated. *(Reviewer round folded 2026-06-08: reframed ego-death → ego-diagnosis.)*

##### What it is (grounded)
- **The whole chorus is Mary's voice — audio-confirmed `[G]` (Jen, recording + official visualizer, 2026-06-15).** She sings the count, the verdict, the *"know 'bout me,"* and even the title: *"A-B-C, count 'em, one, two, three / You got a little bit of money, but it don't come cheap / If you don't know 'bout me, you should know by now / I'm the number one champion in this town."* The *"me"* in *"know 'bout me"* is **hers**.
- **Lucius has no line of his own.** The only words he sings are *"I'm the number one champion in this town,"* and he doesn't even own those — he **comes in on Mary's voice, joining her** on the title line.
- **The ending stages the appropriation as sound `[G]`:** at the close her voice **fades**, his **drowns her out**, she goes **silent**, and he sings the title a couple more times **completely alone** — the last repetition **a cappella, after the music itself has ended.**
- **Structural hinge `[G]`:** the verse ends *"…dropped me dead when she said"* and cuts **straight into Mary's chorus**, opening on *"A-B-C, count 'em, one, two, three."* So **what she "said" = the count** (see Open Questions — resolved).
- Per **EP7**, **Lucius plays it as "another song about ME."** The irony: it was never his — he can only **take it from her**, and his "victory" is to be left boasting alone into silence.
- **Mary is named and rendered faceless:** *"Mary, Mary, so contrary… Saw a halo but I didn't see a head… La Conquistadora with a gun in her hand… fawning over no man… such a revolutionary."*

*(Correction 2026-06-15: previously the whole chorus was filed as the champion's boast. Audio confirms the **chorus is Mary's**; Lucius sings **only** the title line — and only by **joining then overpowering** her, finishing alone a cappella. Supersedes both "champion sings the chorus" and the interim "title-line shared" note — he *joins/takes*, he does not *share*.)*

##### The two voices — diagnosis, not death [W]
- **The champion = ego / Lucius-mode braggadocio.** Status, money, fame, *"know 'bout me"* — a spectacle-self announcing its rank.
- **Mary = the sacred-feminine who dethrones it — but the lyric's weight is on the *looking*, not the dying.** The song spends its lines on *how the champion sees* (desire, surface, status) and almost none on the death itself. So the central move is **ego-diagnosis**: the champion reveals what he is by how he fails to see her. He can process image, status, desire — and **cannot process a presence that won't reduce to image.** He *"made a move like a fool, dropped me dead when she said…"* — he dies not because she is powerful but because his mode of seeing (surveillance) breaks against a presence that demands witnessing.
- So Lucius's "song about ME" is the song where the ego is unseated — the album's anti-ego corrective.

##### The song as a trap for Lucius [G/W]
The structural irony is **demonstrable from the text**, not imposed: in **EP7 Lucius identifies with the anthem** (*"another song about ME"*) [G] — he hears the boast, claims it — **and does not hear the line that executes the character singing it** [W]. The ego is so busy recognizing itself in the chorus that it misses the verse where it's dropped dead. The song is a trap that works *because* the ego takes the bait.

##### The vocal split is the argument [W]
- **Appropriation, made precise.** The whole chorus is Mary's — count, verdict, and title. Lucius has **no line of his own**; he can only sing *"number one champion"* by **climbing onto her voice**, then **drowning her out** at the close. He claims the song ("about ME") but owns none of it — he takes the title by **silencing its true singer**. The appropriation *is* the unseating, and it's **enacted in the mix**, not just argued.
- **Facelessness preserved.** Mary *speaks* (the count) yet stays faceless (*"halo but I didn't see a head"*) — because the count is **pre-personal creation-grammar**, not self-disclosure. The champion's mode is *"know 'bout me"* (speech as self-advertisement); Mary gives utterance without giving a surface.
- **Inversion staged as sound.** Same numerical surface, two objects: the shared title **counts rank**; Mary's *"A-B-C, one two three"* **counts creation**. The [[Inversion]] architecture made audible — call (the contested boast) vs. response (the genuine count); the answer is what drops the champion dead.
- **The sterile close.** Once he's drowned her out, the song ends with Lucius **alone** on the bare title — repeating *"number one champion"* into a dying room, the **last time a cappella, after the music has stopped.** He wins the word and loses everything that gave it meaning: the count, the breath, the music, her. The boast outliving not just its substance but the **song itself** — structure with nothing left to structure (kin to the banana/Cavendish sterile-loop).
- **Structure receives breath.** Mary's count is the hinge where dead letters are **animated into living speech** — the structure-channel (Lucius, words-without-source) answered by the breath ([[SOL]], *"the breath beneath all the verses"*). Stands on JT's own grounded architecture (SOL-breath + Lucius-structure); needs no further scaffolding.

##### Conqueror → conquered [W]
The title chain runs **Champion → Conquistador → Conquistadora**: the song of conquest meets *Our Lady of the Conquest*, and the conqueror is conquered. **Mary is not the prize the champion wins; she is the force that defeats the prize-seeker.** The militarized Marian title (gun in hand) makes her the superior conqueror, not the spoils.

##### Mary, rendered
- **Faceless [G] — holiness without persona; the mirror inverted [W].** *"Halo but I didn't see a head"* = the grounded **faceless divine-feminine** — the same marker as [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Weirdness|Weirdness]] (*"face was out of sight"*) and [[Essays/Concepts/Songs/Ballerina Boy|Ballerina Boy]]'s motherly outro. **This is the real faceless-Mary anchor the [[Mary]] tracker turns on** (vs the corrected Lucius Lullaby false-positive). The champion **perceives the symbol (halo) but not the being (head)** — holiness with no persona to flatter or possess. And it **inverts the mirror motif**: the spectacle-self comes looking for reflection and recognition, and Mary returns neither. She is the **El Roi / faceless-source** function — *the one who sees, not the one who is seen-and-flattered* ([[Witnessing vs Surveillance]]).
- **Armed, autonomous, revolutionary [G].** *"La Conquistadora with a gun in her hand… fawning over no man… such a revolutionary"* — not the meek Mary; a militant, self-possessed conqueror.
- **"Mary, Mary, so contrary" [G]** — the **Mother Goose** nursery rhyme ("…quite contrary"); the album's "twisted adolescent themes" substrate again.
- **Marian titles, repurposed [W/~].** *"La Conquistadora"* is a **real Marian title** (*Our Lady of the Conquest* — the oldest Marian statue in the U.S., Santa Fe), here **militarized** ("with a gun"). *"Queen of California"* repurposes the Marian *"Queen of Heaven"* into the City-of-Angels / Hollywood register (cf. [[City of Angels]]).
- **"Queen of California on the corner doing her time" [W].** The sacred-feminine brought low — street-corner, serving a sentence — yet still "Queen." A **Magdalene** register (fallen-and-holy) `[~]`.
- **"Stumbled into the church… on her knees… quite a scene, making everyone stare" [G].** Disruptive devotion — sacred but scandalous, not decorous.

##### Threads [W]
- **Witnessing vs Surveillance** ([[Witnessing vs Surveillance]]): the champion *looks at* Mary (objectifies; can't see her face) — the consuming gaze — and is dropped. She cannot be possessed by being looked at.
- **Mary as threshold-intervention** ([[Mary]]: "appears when recursion destabilizes"): she interrupts the looped boast (`recursion_state: loop`) and ends it.

- [x] ~~Mary *"dropped me dead when she said…"* — the line she says is unstated.~~ **RESOLVED 2026-06-15:** the verse cuts straight into the chorus and Mary's voice opens it, so **what she said = *"A-B-C, count 'em, one, two, three…"*** `[G]` (structure + vocal split). The **count** is what drops the champion dead `[W]` — not a withheld secret but the creation-grammar he can't survive hearing.
